name: Spiked Goji Tea
search_text: Spiked goji tea. Warm, easy, crowd pleaser, batch drink. Goji berries, dried longan, red dates simmered with rock sugar, cut with aged rum or brandy. Tastes like a hot toddy. Good for a party or a cold night. Low effort, low proof compared to spirit forward drinks.
tasting_notes: Warm, sweet, a little medicinal in the best way. Red date and longan do hot toddy work.

base.name: Goji tea (party batch)
steps: Simmer goji, dried longan, and red dates in water on low heat for about 20 minutes.
Sweeten to taste with rock sugar and keep warm for serving.

method: Serve the goji tea base warm.
Stir in aged rum or brandy just before serving.

name: Roasted Oolong Highball
search_text: Roasted oolong highball. Whisky forward, malty, nutty, almost smoky, not a novelty drink. Overnight cold brewed roasted oolong tea, Japanese whisky, soda water, big ice, lemon peel. Long, refreshing, tastes like a real cocktail not a tea gimmick.
tasting_notes: Nutty, roasted, whisky adjacent even before the whisky goes in. Long and refreshing.

base.name: Roasted oolong cold brew
steps: Steep 4g roasted oolong per 500ml cold water in the fridge overnight.

method: Combine whisky and cold brewed oolong over big ice.
Express lemon peel over the top and drop it in.

name: Osmanthus Gin Sour
search_text: Osmanthus gin sour. Floral, clean, pretty, a little showy, good for someone who wants something delicate and citrus forward. Dried osmanthus flower syrup, gin, lemon juice, optional egg white for texture. Not smoky, not boozy tasting, approachable.
tasting_notes: Floral, bright, clean citrus. The prettiest of the four, especially with the egg white foam.

base.name: Osmanthus syrup
steps: Steep 2 tbsp dried osmanthus in 1 cup hot water with 1 cup rock sugar.

method: Dry shake gin, syrup, lemon juice, and egg white (if using) without ice.
Add ice and shake again hard.

name: Suanmeitang, Smoke on Smoke
search_text: Suanmeitang mezcal cocktail. Smoky, tart, dark, unusual, nobody has had this before, great non alcoholic option too. Smoked plum, hawthorn, tangerine peel, licorice root simmered and finished with osmanthus, split with mezcal or rye and lime. Also works completely sober served straight over ice.
tasting_notes: Smoky, tart, dark, a little medicinal. The mezcal doubles down on the smoke instead of fighting it.

base.name: Suanmeitang base
steps: Simmer smoked plum, hawthorn, tangerine peel, and licorice root for 40 minutes.
Finish with a splash of osmanthus syrup before serving.

method: For non drinkers: serve the suanmeitang base straight over ice.
For a cocktail: split 2 oz suanmeitang base with 1.5 oz mezcal or rye and a lime squeeze over ice.
